findings.detail: The earlier audit of these bytes (5378ea6efd4b-fr) recorded a NIT claiming 'lecture' is mostly the audio sense in this corpus (it cited 53 values, 'most' audio). Re-checked here rather than inherited: 70 fr values contain 'lecture', 16 of them explicitly audio, and the data-read sense is established by shipped strings ('Requête de lecture', 'Lecture impossible', 'Lecture des sessions'). The premise does not hold on the corpus, so the NIT is not carried forward. Nothing is deleted - the earlier audit stands under `superseded` on the row.
